for: ChatGPT image generation. One boss per chat. Attach assets/bosses/boss-hoa-president-v1.png and boss-performance-review-v1.png as style and grid references.

shared_rules.sheet: 576x456 logical pixels (ideally exported 3x at 1728x1368): 4 columns x 3 rows of 144x152 cells, no grid lines, no labels
shared_rules.frames: 0-5 walk cycle, 6-7 wind-up, 8-9 attack, 10 hurt (comic, no injury), 11 completely blank
shared_rules.foot_point: local (72,148) in every cell; same scale, head size, outfit and camera angle in every cell; 4px clear margin
shared_rules.style: hard 16-bit pixel clusters, one-pixel navy outline, three hue-shifted tones per material, warm upper-left light, 3/4 top-down view, big friendly head
shared_rules.background: exact flat opaque magenta #FF00FF everywhere outside the art, no floor, no cast shadow, no glow
shared_rules.color: neutral white balance, no sepia, no golden haze, no film-look tint
shared_rules.forbidden: text, letters, numbers, logos, brands, watermarks, real people

bosses.name: The Reorg
bosses.concept: A cheerful management consultant who rolls in with a whiteboard org chart and rearranges everything.

physical_description.build: tall and lanky, long arms, confident forward lean
physical_description.head: big friendly head, slicked-back dark hair with one stubborn cowlick, thin rectangular glasses, wide salesman grin
physical_description.outfit: slate-blue suit jacket over a cream shirt, sleeves rolled to the elbow, teal tie loosened, warm tan trousers, russet loafers
physical_description.props: pushes a rolling whiteboard on a navy stand; the board shows only boxes connected by arrows (no writing); a coffee-orange dry-erase marker in his other hand; a few sticky notes stuck to the board edges

poses.0-5: walk pushing the whiteboard, alternating strides, board wheels turning, sticky notes flutter
poses.6: wind-up: stops, spins the whiteboard to face forward, raises the marker
poses.7: wind-up: marker high, about to slash a big arrow across the chart, eyebrows up
poses.8: attack: swings the marker in a big sweep, arrows on the board swap places, sticky notes burst outward
poses.9: follow-through: arms wide, 'ta-da' pose, board tilted
poses.10: hurt: glasses askew, sticky notes falling off the board, startled

telegraph.look: two dashed rectangles (cream dashes on magenta) with curved coffee-orange swap arrows between them, like a floor plan being rearranged, no text

bosses.gameplay_note_for_claude: reshuffles the room: desks slide, spawn points move

bosses.name: The Holiday Party
bosses.concept: The coworker who leads the conga line at the office holiday party and will not let you leave.

physical_description.build: short and round, bouncy, always mid-dance
physical_description.head: big friendly head, rosy cheeks, huge grin, curly russet hair under a lopsided pointed paper party hat (teal with cream stripes)
physical_description.outfit: a chunky ugly holiday sweater in sage and russet with cream snowflakes and a knitted reindeer (generic, no characters or brands), a tinsel scarf in coffee orange, tan khakis, novelty socks in pink and cream
physical_description.props: holds a cup of red punch in one hand, a sprig of mistletoe (green leaves, white berries) dangling from a stick tied to the party hat
physical_description.personality: joyful, relentless, a little too close

poses.0-5: conga dance walk: hip bumps, kicks to the side on frames 2 and 5, punch cup held high without spilling
poses.6: wind-up: points at you with the punch cup, eyebrows waggle
poses.7: wind-up: crouches, arms out, mistletoe swinging forward
poses.8: attack: big leaping hug lunge toward the viewer, tinsel flying
poses.9: follow-through: lands in a 'come on, one more song' pose, punch sloshes
poses.10: hurt: party hat knocked sideways, punch splashes on sweater, shocked

telegraph.look: a circle of mistletoe sprigs and tinsel loops on the floor, with small cream sparkles, no text

bosses.gameplay_note_for_claude: conga line of followers; mistletoe zones freeze you for an awkward second

bosses.name: Your New Boss (Age 26)
bosses.concept: Your brand-new manager, half your age, running on energy drinks and motivational quotes.

physical_description.build: slim and springy, bouncing on the balls of his feet, always too fast
physical_description.head: big friendly head, youthful face, swoopy tousled hair with a slight fade, wireless earbuds, eager wide eyes
physical_description.outfit: a sage quilted fleece vest over a slate hoodie with the collar of a cream button-down poking out, tan joggers, bright white and coffee-orange sneakers, a lanyard badge
physical_description.props: a tall generic energy drink can (lavender and orange, no logo or text) in one hand, a phone in the other
physical_description.personality: relentlessly positive, means well, has never seen a fax machine

poses.0-5: fast jogging walk, can swinging, sneakers squeak (big strides)
poses.6: wind-up: chugs the energy drink, eyes widen
poses.7: wind-up: crushes the can, points both finger-guns forward
poses.8: attack: dashing burst toward the viewer, arm thrust out in an encouraging point, little cream speed lines
poses.9: follow-through: thumbs up, slides to a stop
poses.10: hurt: earbud pops out, phone fumbles, wide-eyed 'oh no'

telegraph.look: a straight dash lane of coffee-orange chevrons with cream starbursts at the end, like a pep-talk sprint, no text

bosses.gameplay_note_for_claude: fast; every attack comes with a pep talk line

props.name: Hot Desk (The Reorg's rolling desk)
props.sheet: 192x64 logical: 2 cells of 96x64. Cell 0 resting, cell 1 rolling (casters turned, a few cream motion ticks behind it). Footprint is the bottom 96x56; draw the 3/4 top-down view so the desk top shows

physical_description.desk: a small modern office desk on four navy caster wheels, slate-blue metal legs, a tan laminate top with a thin teal edge band
physical_description.on_top: a closed laptop, a coffee-orange mug, a lavender sticky note, a tiny cream tent card with no text (the 'hot desk' placard)

props.style: same as the boss sheets: hard 16-bit pixel clusters, one-pixel navy outline, three tones per material, warm upper-left light
props.background: exact flat opaque magenta #FF00FF, no floor shadow
props.color: neutral white balance, no sepia, no golden haze, no film-look tint
props.forbidden: text, letters, numbers, logos, brands, watermarks
